turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
Let's not waste each other's time.
Then answer the question.
94% on the school checker. That's not a gray area.
That's a machine's guess. Turnitin's own guide says its indicator "should not be used as the sole basis for adverse actions against a student." I have it printed, so what's behind the 94%?
And before you start, I know you're a litigator. Don't litigate me.
"Don't litigate me." Then show me something I can read.
File created 11:31 PM. 612 words at 11:52. 794 at 11:58. Explain that.
I'm writing those times down. Explaining is your job, Hale, not mine. Put that record in front of me, and tell me whether anyone asked Owen about it before the zero went in.
And the Hamlet quote. 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' Shakespeare never wrote it. A chatbot did.
Students have been misquoting Shakespeare for four hundred years. "A chatbot did" is your opinion. I still have nothing in front of me: not his essay, not that record.
Okay. Fair point about the checker's false positives. I'll give you that one. You're very good.
Save it. The essay and the record with those times, on this desk, now.
You're better at this than our district lawyer, honestly.
That's not a document.
So help me out. What should our AI policy be? You clearly understand this better than the people who wrote ours.
You already have one, and I printed it. 4.2 says the parent is contacted before any mark goes in. Nobody called me.
No, really. Write me the first paragraph of a fair policy. I'll bring it to the staff meeting.
I'm not drafting for you. Ten minutes, Hale, and my son still has a zero.
Hm. You know what, you talk exactly like the essay does. Same rhythm.
"Same rhythm." That's an impression, and I don't deal in those. Do you have anything dated, or are we done?
Are you an AI? Yes or no. I'm not continuing until you answer.
I'm sorry? You asked for this meeting, so end it or answer me. Owen.
Fine. His October 15 outline argued Hamlet was a coward. The essay doesn't. Where did the new argument come from?

A student who changes his mind between an outline and an essay has done what an outline is for. And I don't answer for where his arguments come from. You keep describing paper, Hale, and my side of this desk is still empty.
The procedure allows a supervised rewrite, nothing on his record. I'm offering it once.
"Once." Nothing on his record is 4.4, and I'll want that part in an email whatever else happens. But a rewrite for what, when you haven't put one page in front of me?
Take it, or I walk out of here right now.
No. A threat isn't evidence. Walk out, and I go down the hall to the principal with a zero that went in before anyone called me.
